reading.title: Asking about a gesture
reading.text: At a workshop, Mona sees her colleague shrug. She asks about the signal. The trainer explains that mime uses movement without words. Another participant can sign in a sign language. A wink is a quick movement of one eyelid. Mona does not assume the same meaning for every movement. She asks the person and respects their answer. A picture is not enough to identify a complete sign language.
